name: Gentleman’s Club
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 5; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 9,300 gp

DESCRIPTION

This +1 club is an elegant and refined weapon, not unlike a walking cane with a large knob on the top. Although it is stylish and debonair, it is also a weapon. Anyone observing or inspecting this object can make a Perception check (DC 20) to recognize it as a true weapon, rather than a walking stick.

Although the gentleman’s club is a lethal weapon, it can be used to inflict nonlethal damage with no penalty to the attack roll. Furthermore, when used this way, a gentleman’s club inflicts an additional 1d6 points of nonlethal damage per strike.

Lastly, the wielder of this weapon also gains a +4 to Diplomacy checks when dealing with heterosexual members of the opposite gender.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells magic weapon; Cost 4,650 gp
